item.title: MAMA Study: pregnant women with inflammatory arthritis being treated with a biologic | NRAS
item.description: The Monoclonal Antibody Medications in inflammatory Arthritis: stopping or continuing in pregnancy (MAMA) study. This research is for pregnant women with inflammatory arthritis who are being treated with a biologic. The MAMA Study is looking to provide an answer on which is the better approach.
